_comment: Copy this, edit it, run: npm run voice:ab:call -- <your-file.json>. Variant A with an empty env is the baseline — exactly what .env says today. Every key must be a real env key (checked against .env.example) and at least one must differ between variants, or the run refuses to start.

variants.label: דיבור איטי יותר (0.85) וקצת חזק יותר
